channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Natural World

channel.title: Sisters in Country: Dolly, Linda and Emmylou
channel.desc: An exploration of how Dolly Parton, Linda Ronstadt and Emmylou Harris's careers took off in the 1970s. Each had a very distinct take on country, but they ended up uniting as close harmony singers and eventually collaborated on 1987's four-million-selling debut album, 'Trio'.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Dolly Parton at the BBC
channel.desc: A look back at some of Dolly Parton's finest performances at the BBC, incorporating her greatest moments and hits such as 'Jolene', '9 to 5', 'Islands in the Stream' and 'Here You Come Again'.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Landward
channel.desc: The Landward team return for the autumn. Dougie is in the Cairngorms finding out how wildlife and precious habitats have been impacted by the summer's devastating wildfire. Anne reports from the ongoing scene of the fire to see the collective effort to put it out. Shahbaz is in Tayside meeting the scientists using technology to select the crops of the future. And Cammy learns the ropes as he takes part in a clifftop rescue with the coastguard.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Nigel and Adam's Farm Kitchen
channel.desc: Nigel cooks up our favourite ready meal, lasagne and tries to match the price of the off-the-shelf version of this popular dish. Adam meanwhile, sets his own challenge to grow durum wheat, used to make pasta, on the Cotswolds farm.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Natural World
channel.desc: Real-life drama about a family chimps, who are trapped in the lost world of the Kyambura. This deep and ancient forested gorge runs through the African savannah and for years, it has been cut off from the rest of the jungle, leaving the chimps imprisoned. Here, they face a daily life-or-death dilemma; whether to leave the safety of the gorge and venture into the predator-ridden savannah to find food, or face hunger.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: The Big Deal

channel.desc: Coverage of the 2026 World Road Cycling Championships.

David Barby finds six tasty sandwich makers and Michael Baggott digs out a 400-year-old Laurel gold coin circa 1603-1625. Presenter Paul also visits Temple Newsam, a 17th century house being restored to its former glory by a dedicated and skilled restoration team.

Two-time winner Alex Noren defends the title he won in 2025 after a dramatic play-off victory last year.

channel.title: Africa
channel.desc: David Attenborough takes a breathtaking journey through the vast and diverse continent of Africa as it has never been seen before. In Africa's ancient south west corner, two extraordinary deserts sit side by side. Water is in short supply, yet these deserts are somehow full of life because the creatures that live here have turned the rules of survival on their head. This film celebrates nature's ingenuity, no matter how tough it gets. In the Kalahari scrublands, clever meerkats are outsmarted by a wily bird, solitary and belligerent black rhinos get together to party and giant insects stalk huge flocks of birds. Rain almost never falls in the Namib - instead it must make do with vaporous, vanishing fog. The creatures in this, the world's oldest desert, have gone to the extremes, as spiders wheel to escape and a desert giraffe fights to defend his scant resources in the greatest giraffe battle ever filmed.

channel.desc: Remembering Sept. 11, 2001, through the stories of Americans who were at the White House, the U.S. Capitol, the Pentagon and in the skies above Washington, D.C.

channel.name: CSPAN 3 US

channel.desc: Remembering Sept. 11, 2001 through the stories of Americans who were at the White House, U.S. Capitol, the Pentagon and in the skies above Washington.

channel.name: CSPAN 3 US
channel.title: Anchoring 9/11 - The Day and the Decade
channel.desc: Current and former news anchors for ABC, CBS, CNN and FOX talk about their coverage of the terrorist attacks of September 11, 2001, and the years since. Marvin Kalb moderates the program.

channel.name: CSPAN 3 US
channel.title: A CIA Officer in Afghanistan After 9/11
channel.desc: Former CIA officer Duane Evans talks about his book, "Foxtrot in Kandahar," which recounts his tour of duty in southern Afghanistan shortly after the 9/11 terrorist attacks.

channel.name: CSPAN 3 US
channel.title: September 11 Commission Final Report
channel.desc: The National Commission on Terrorist Attacks Upon the United States releases its final report after investigating the events of September 11, 2001. Former Gov. Thomas Kean (R-NJ) chairs the commission. The vice chair is former Rep. Lee Hamilton (D-I.

channel.name: CSPAN 3 US
channel.title: 9/11 Twenty Five Years
channel.desc: C-SPAN tours the National September 11 Memorial & Museum in New York City to mark the 25th anniversary of the September 11, 2001, attacks.

channel.name: CSPAN 3 US
channel.title: 9/11 Twenty Five Years
channel.desc: C-SPAN tours the permanent outdoor memorial to the 184 people who were killed in the Pentagon and on American Airlines Flight 77 during the September 11, 2001, attacks.

channel.name: CSPAN 3 US
channel.title: 9/11 Pentagon Attack Fire Truck Wreckage
channel.desc: C-SPAN tours the Gen. George Patton Museum's exhibitions on military history and leadership located at Fort Knox, Kentucky.

channel.name: CSPAN 3 US
channel.title: C-SPAN Tours the National Archives' Remembering 9/11 Exhibit
channel.desc: C-SPAN tours the display of artifacts from September 11, 2001, on view at the National Archives in Washington, D.C.

channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques - and even a paint cannon.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Peppa spots a new playground! The children race over to it and discover that it's rather odd. Grampy Rabbit explains, this isn't a playground - it's an exercise park.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Daddy Pig thinks perhaps he should run the London Marathon to teach his children about determination! Daddy enlists Peppa and George to help with training in the park.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
